content: Hello, this is Carla from University Accounts. How can I assist you with your records today?
Hi Carla, I want to make sure my tuition payment went through. I used Zelle last night.
Absolutely, I can check that for you right away. Could you confirm if you sent the payment to the bursar@coaschool.edu Zelle account? Our records usually update within 12 hours.
Yes, I sent $4,200 to bursar@coaschool.edu at 9:08 PM yesterday. My student ID is 2103349.

Thank you for those details, and I see the $4,200 Zelle transaction from your profile linked to student ID 2103349. The payment reference code is ZEL-9875231. That's the same process you followed for last semester's deposit, so there shouldn't be any issues.
Great. Do you need my name or anything else to confirm?
I have you as Matthew Chen, correct? Your email is mchen22@coaschool.edu. Everything matches. Since you submitted before the 10 AM deadline today, your course registration won't be delayed.
Yes, that's me. Can I get a payment confirmation for my records?
Of course! I'll email a confirmation receipt for Zelle transaction ZEL-9875231 to mchen22@coaschool.edu within the next hour. Let us know if you need it expedited for any urgent enrollment needs.
